name: Twisted Hatred
summary: Near Teldrassil’s settlements, Lord Melenas has rallied the grell at Fel Rock. Tallonkai Swiftroot sends trusted champions to stop the satyr before he threatens the night elves.

sections.title: A Bitter Disgrace
sections.body: Satyrs carry an ancient betrayal in kaldorei history. During the War of the Ancients, they were Highborne who gave themselves to the Burning Legion. Now one has taken hold on Teldrassil, the young World Tree meant as a sanctuary. For Tallonkai Swiftroot and the defenders who stand with him, that presence is a bitter disgrace.

sections.title: The Threat at Fel Rock
sections.body: North of the nearby paths, Fel Rock’s corrupted caverns crawl with feral grell. Lord Melenas has gathered the chaotic creatures into a hostile force under his will. Tallonkai fears what the satyr may unleash upon the World Tree’s boughs, and demands a swift, quiet end. He wants Melenas slain and his severed head brought back.

faq.answer: Lord Melenas is a satyr who has claimed Fel Rock in northern Teldrassil. He commands aggressive grell warriors and schemes to spread corruption through the World Tree.

faq.q: Where can I find Lord Melenas?
faq.answer: Lord Melenas lurks deep within Fel Rock, north of Dolanaar in Teldrassil. Grell and other corrupted creatures surround him.

faq.q: Why does Tallonkai Swiftroot want this kept secret?
aliases: why must this stay between us
faq.answer: Satyrs recall the night elves’ ancient betrayal during the War of the Ancients. A satyr’s bold presence within the young World Tree is a disgrace, and Tallonkai wants to resolve it without widespread panic.

faq.q: What is the relationship between satyrs and grell?
faq.answer: Grell are small, mischievous wild creatures, naturally corrupted and found across Teldrassil. Satyrs can bully or bend these lesser creatures to serve their ambitions.

faq.q: Why are there satyrs on Teldrassil in the first place?
faq.answer: Teldrassil was grown only a few years ago, yet corruption and dark beings quickly reached the island despite the druids’ hopes for a clean sanctuary. Satyrs slipped in and made footholds in shadowy places like Fel Rock.
Tallonkai Swiftroot is a night elf guardian stationed near Dolanaar. He watches for threats to Teldrassil and sends adventurers against nearby pockets of corruption.

angles.text: As a night elf, you face an ancient reminder of your ancestors’ fall to demonic ambition. Defeating Lord Melenas is a duty to the World Tree and an act of ancestral penance.
As a druid, you find Melenas and his corrupted grell poisoning the fragile balance of Teldrassil’s young wilderness.
